name: structure-first-reconstruction-hierarchy
privacy: The user-provided comparison images are not copied into the repository; this file records a generalized reconstruction problem only.
source_case: A vertically framed asymmetric triangular megastructure with a central light slit, a partially occluded circular relief, a layered city, river, grassland, and a tiny observer.

required_reconstruction_spec.coordinate_system: Use normalized canvas coordinates only when they materially improve strict reconstruction; mark them as approximate rather than pixel-exact.
skeleton: outer silhouette and subject bounding region
dominant vertical, horizontal, diagonal, circular, and perspective axes
visual center of gravity and primary direction
proportions: landmark centers and sizes relative to the canvas and primary subject
pairwise distances and ratios between identity-defining parts
negative_spaces: openings, gaps, wedges, and intervals inside the subject
which object occludes which and the approximate visible fraction
tonal_masses: dominant light, midtone, and dark regions
light direction and the structural plane each value describes
depth: ordered foreground, middle-ground, subject, and background layers
scale reduction, overlap, contrast loss, atmospheric perspective, and reflections where visible
required_reconstruction_spec.detail_gate: Texture, inscriptions, cracks, grain, and decorative motifs are compiled only after the structure fields are complete and must never compensate for a missing or contradictory P0 relationship.

hard_gates: Any missing or contradictory P0 identity relationship fails the reconstruction regardless of total score.
A wrong crop, silhouette, primary proportion, negative space, or major occlusion cannot be offset by detailed texture.
Prompt compilation must place structural facts before high-salience decorative detail.
comparison_loop: When the user supplies generated results, compare them against the reconstruction spec rather than only checking whether named objects exist.
Identify at most the two highest-impact error classes per revision.
Lock already-correct P0 fields and revise only the affected canonical or adapter constraints.
Do not claim pixel-level certainty or invent measurements unsupported by the image.
Do not generate or retry images unless the user explicitly requests generation; when explicitly requested, stop after three automatic correction rounds unless the user asks to continue.
pass_criteria: The reconstruction hierarchy is platform-neutral and runs before target adapter selection.
All six platform-language prompts preserve the same skeleton, proportions, negative spaces, tonal structure, and depth order.
Fine texture remains lower priority than global geometry in every platform prompt.
The existing model-aware adapter rules, six-block Markdown contract, and source-image persistence behavior remain intact.
